title: 32 North McGee Drive
meta_description: This beautiful vacation rental home occupies a prime location on the North Turtle Bale pedestrian path and equidistant from the Caliza pool complex and the new Silva pool complex (opening March 2026). The home offers three bedrooms, all with private bath
description_expanded: This beautiful vacation rental home occupies a prime location on the North Turtle Bale pedestrian path and equidistant from the Caliza pool complex and the new Silva pool complex (opening March 2026). The home offers three bedrooms, all with private baths. On the first level, guests will find a spacious living room, dining area and kitchen with large center island. A butler’s pantry off of the kitchen offers additional storage and a work space with desk. The first floor also features the laundry room as well as the primary bedroom with one king-sized bed, a spacious closet and bathroom offering both a walk-in shower and soaking tub. The courtyard has a plunge pool, outdoor seating and a built-in grill. On the second floor, you will find a spacious, covered terrace with ample seating overlooking the pedestrian path below. A sink, ice machine, mini fridge and television complete this area. Two additional king bedrooms with private baths complete this level. Parking is available in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
